author: From staff reports
title: Theatre Bristol to hold stage combat workshop
text: BRISTOL -- Theatre Bristol's Cathy DeCaterina School of Theatre Arts will present a stage combat workshop on Saturday, Sept. 19, from 10:30 a.m. to 12:30 p.m. at Theatre Bristol, 512 State St., Bristol, TN. Registration is online at www.TheatreBristol.org/tbarts. Registration closes one hour prior to the workshop. Learn how to throw punches, slap, kick, stomp, pull hair and more, without leaving a mark. Camille Gray teaches the fundamentals of unarmed hand-to-hand stage combat in this workshop. Even if you've performed stage combat before, come brush up on your technique, review the rules and learn and perform a fun combo. The Cathy DeCaterina School of Theatre Arts is open to all ages and experience levels seeking to improve their theatre skills, build confidence, prepare for upcoming productions or enjoy just for fun. A range of classes and workshops are taught for children and adults with topics for artists who want to be onstage, backstage or both. Workshops include acting, musical theatre dance, costume design, set design, lighting and sound design, understanding scripts, directing, stage management, makeup, choral singing, dialects, creative dramatics and more. Audition workshops run periodically featuring the directors of upcoming Theatre Bristol productions. New workshops are added regularly. For more information, visit the Theatre Bristol's website or Facebook page, contact Theatre Bristol at 423-212-3625 or email info@theatrebristol.org.
